"I asked the workers that they were doing. 
One yelled 'Splash World Aquaslide!' 
and threw his tools at me."

entities.text:
"The first thing of note I saw was 
the ancient aqueduct. A true wonder! 
Workmen were striking it with hammers."

"As I didnt understand the language
I assumed it was some conservation project. 
How lovely to see old relics being saved!"
